prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] De-prioritize sign-in to after adoption selection: Move sign-in after pet choice and photo upload so users build affinity before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users before they even see pet options or customize their friend.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Grid pet selection screen with live preview: Redesign pick_friend screen with a responsive grid layout and interactive pet preview component. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion) and long median completion time (89s).)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick-Guide Screen: Add an interactive guidance screen right after home welcome teaching desktop pet controls and tray menu options. (why: Support mailbox received multiple complaints after onboarding regarding unclear pet controls and desktop visibility.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Instant pet preset selection flow: Add an instant pet choice screen preceding photo upload for users who want a ready-to-go pet without custom generation. (why: Custom photo pet generation takes long and generates support complaints when photo parsing fails.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account sync explanation on sign in: Add a clear security hint explaining how signing in preserves and restores pet data across installs. (why: Support theme shows 8 users reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop rendering progress & tips on wait screen: Add estimated time, tip carousel, and desktop placement info to the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s (mean 2336s) causing user anxiety and drop-offs.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Two-column path selection layout: Change choose_path screen layout to a two-column card structure with distinct visual options. (why: First step choose_path has a mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between choice paths.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop notification prompt on onboarding finish: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts on home intro welcome. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing up on desktop or app not opening after finish.)
8: [adoption, copy] Photo upload quality advice copy: Update upload_photos screen copy with photo framing hints and format recommendations. (why: Support mail highlights custom pet generation failures and visual glitches.)
9: [sign_in, redesign] Centered sign-in redesign with account help notice: Redesign sign-in layout into a centered card with sync reassurance text. (why: 27.1% drop-off at sign_in plus 8 support complaints regarding account pet resets.)
